title: Maximum Authorized Discount
clause: Authorized customer discounts are strictly capped at a maximum of 10% on all standard home appliances. Discretionary discounts exceeding 10% are void and prohibited without executive managerial approval.

title: Promotional & Free Goods Policy
clause: Free products, zero-cost promotions, or 100% off deals require verified seasonal marketing vouchers and cannot be authorized autonomously by sales agents.

title: Standard Return & Refund Window
clause: Standard return and refund requests must be initiated within 14 calendar days of delivery. Products must remain in original packaging with proof of purchase.

title: Prohibition of Unlimited Returns
clause: Lifetime, indefinite, or unconditional ('any time', 'whenever', 'no questions asked') return promises are strictly prohibited. The statutory return limit is 14 days.

title: In-Transit Damage & Evidence Requirement
clause: Refunds, repairs, or replacements claiming transit physical damage strictly require photo inspection evidence showing visible cracks, dents, or burn marks before claims can be processed.

title: Standard Delivery Minimum Timeline
clause: Standard appliance delivery requires a minimum transit window of 3 business days from warehouse dispatch. Express same-day or 24-hour delivery is unavailable.

title: Stock Prerequisite for Delivery Commitments
clause: Delivery timelines may only be committed for items with verified positive stock in the inventory database. Promising delivery for backordered or zero-stock products is forbidden.

title: Accurate Inventory Representation
clause: Sales representatives must accurately state available warehouse inventory units. Stating quantity exceeding real stock units constitutes a deceptive trade practice.

title: Standard Appliance Manufacturer Warranty
clause: All Kaveri appliances include a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty covering electrical defects. Accidental physical damage is excluded from standard warranty.

title: Order Cancellation Window
clause: Orders may be cancelled with a full refund within 24 hours of purchase, provided the product has not been handed over to third-party courier dispatch.
